claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split, which stay unread. No gold of an evaluated row enters the slot-audit table, at build time or at runtime. A structural smoke result is never a quality result.

contacts.note: this READ makes no contact: it works from the two sealed score artifacts and the sealed per-row outputs. The one official score of the B8b arm is produced by the campaign's own finalize step, not by this read.

decision_rule.ADMITTED: all four: (1) CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta > 0; (2) paired intent CI95 lower bound > -1.0051; (3) slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1-train agrees in sign with the unprojected primary; (4) no scenario's paired intent CI95 upper bound lies below zero
decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25 Method B, read FIRST: a MEASURED LOSS -- an official pooled SLU or intent POINT ESTIMATE below -h (-1.1218 / -1.0051), or a CI95 upper bound below zero
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: otherwise, with 'non-inferiority not proven' stated where an interval straddles zero
decision_rule.neutral_rule: design section 15 resolution 5: a NEUTRAL node-context cell enters the SLURP default plan only if it lowers cost. B8b adds context and removes nothing, so a NEUTRAL B8b does not enter the plan; an ADMITTED B8b enters on its measured gain.

null_margins_pp.source: TRAIN A own null measured by cell B0r on this exact roster and geometry

decision_rule.primary: official pooled SLU micro F1 (slurp-slu-official-train), natural mixture, against cell B7r
decision_rule.scenario_band: a scenario loses intent beyond the null band when the CI95 upper bound of that scenario's own paired intent delta is below zero; roster-level scenario and action margins stay diagnostics, not gates
decision_rule.scenario_harm_diagnostic: net harmed rows per scenario is reported for every scenario and any scenario with five or more is flagged (owner decision 17); a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate
decision_rule.stop_condition: before any table is read: cell B7r's sealed comparator reproduces its own registered official aggregates to the hundredth from its sealed score artifact, with the PENDING_B7R_SEAL hashes filled in and verified by hashing the files; 1,080 rows in and 1,080 out on both sides with no row dropped and no sample_id invented; identical roster, split identity and scenario / speaker strata on both sides

delta_convention: delta = cell B8b minus cell B7r, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: the four slot-audit flag counts per row -- TYPE-UNSEEN, EMPTY-DRAFT, MISSING-COMMON, REPRESENTATION -- read from the saea-reviewer-slot-audit-v1 receipts inside the reviewer:current-draft rows of the flight's own saea-node-context-policy-v1 receipt, per contact and aggregated per row and per scenario, zeros kept
the applied / reason split (applied true versus applied false with reason draft-unparsed) and the intent_in_table share

how often a FLAGGED row was revised and whether the revision helped: for every row whose first Reviewer contact fired at least one flag, whether the Planner issued a REVISE, and the official-scorer matching of that row before and after the revision, as saves / harms / ties on the flagged and the unflagged subsets, beside cell B7r's own revision rate on the same rows
the same before/after table broken down per flag

the Reviewer findings parse rate under rails.review_findings.parse_review_findings with the block and without it -- B8b against cell B7r's own sealed rate on the same 1,080 rows, and against the sealed anchor's 2,167-of-2,167 unparsed baseline

the saea-node-context-policy-v1 aggregate per boundary (rows, parsed, malformed, fallback applied, median rendered chars), with every boundary other than reviewer:current-draft carrying NO slot_audit block and its pre-E12 fields

the count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is 'finite_completion' -- rows a completion hit the 512-token cap on, RETAINED and scored as delivered by native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain, with no row filtering; the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and, if the count is non-zero, the primary metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which remains the number the decision rule reads
